text: Do not punish a user solely because of one ambiguous message. Review context, previous behavior and evidence. AI recommendations are assistance, not proof.
When two users are mutually escalating, prefer the private AI mediation flow. Serious scam, threat, doxxing or staff-abuse claims should be reviewed by human staff with evidence.
Screenshots can be useful but may be incomplete or edited. Staff should verify message links, IDs, timestamps and server logs where possible.
AI may summarize an appeal but must not decide whether a punishment is upheld or removed. A human moderator or administrator makes the decision.
